subject.title: [Bug] OpenClaw UI WebSocket reconnect 导致会话 terminated

question: Should this broad reconnect-terminated tracker remain open until terminated-run behavior is separately proven, or should maintainers consolidate the remaining Control UI in-flight recovery work under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90755?
rationale: Current source shows partial mitigations and a narrower canonical in-flight visibility issue, but this report contains broader terminated-run evidence that automation should not discard without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep broad tracker open
options.body: Keep this issue open for the terminated-run/reconnect family while using the narrower linked issues and PRs for implementation slices.

options.title: Consolidate under the Control UI tracker
options.body: Close this later as duplicate only if maintainers decide the remaining user problem is fully represented by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90755.

options.title: Split terminated-run lifecycle work
options.body: Create a narrower issue for embedded-run `terminated` without nearby reconnect and link https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90755 for visible in-flight recovery.

recommendation.title: Keep broad tracker open
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for the terminated-run/reconnect family while using the narrower linked issues and PRs for implementation slices.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership and the related maintainer reconnect-resume design issue make this the best available owner for the consolidation/product decision.
